# `fnox remove`

- **Usage:** `fnox remove [-g --global] [-n --dry-run] <KEY>`
- **Aliases:** `rm`, `delete`

Remove a secret

## Arguments

- **`<KEY>`** — Secret key to remove

## Flags

- **`-g --global`** — Remove from the global config file (~/.config/fnox/config.toml)
- **`-n --dry-run`** — Show what would be removed without making changes
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- fnox examples:start -->

## Examples

Remove a secret definition from fnox configuration. The command does not delete or revoke the original value in a remote provider.

```sh
fnox remove OLD_TOKEN --dry-run
fnox remove OLD_TOKEN
```
